cards: Card identifier hashes the canonical UTF-8 LF payload without card_id. Card file manifest hashes full card bytes.
package_artifacts: Raw downloaded wheel bytes with x1-pinned SHA-256.
promotion_receipts: Raw local and promoted checkout bytes. Generated YAML metadata retains its observed CRLF byte domain. Canonical checks raw promoted bytes against the promotion receipt and LF-normalized promoted text against immutable Git blobs.
self_exclusions: Stage manifests self-exclude their own manifest and review receipt. Final stage also declares owner-manifest and content-seal as terminal derivative exclusions. The owner manifest excludes itself and content-seal; the content seal binds the owner manifest and the external canonical binds the exact final commit.
stage_and_owner_manifests: Exact Git blob bytes after the declared LF text filter.
